scope: Tasks Inbox short-title row body width fix; independent production-source review and native compact-disclosure verification
reasoning: Only the outer ListTile title Column changes from start to stretch for the task-row fix. Its existing opaque GestureDetector now covers the full allocated title column; inner title/notes stay left aligned.
Leading checkbox and trailing menu/drag controls remain outside that column and retain existing callbacks and gesture ownership.

Checklist disclosure outer Align may take the allocated title-column width; the inner Semantics/SizedBox/Stack/InkResponse keeps the explicit compact width. Align delegates hit testing to the positioned child and does not create a full-row disclosure tap target.
No Task/Food storage, text engine, durable record or command semantics change is involved in this task-row fix.

tests.regression_authorship: Reviewer authored task_body_hit_test.dart; final production fix was authored by root. Test-file review is explicitly a self-review.
